Supreme Court affirms right to walk, highlights footpath issues

The Supreme Court has ruled that the right to walk is a fundamental right, drawing attention to the poor condition and encroachment of footpaths in urban areas. This ruling underscores the need for accessible and safe pedestrian infrastructure, particularly in cities like Delhi and Noida. The court's directive emphasizes the importance of prioritizing pedestrian safety and convenience over unauthorized constructions on sidewalks.
